description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - shelf sweep: finding one thing on a big shelf, you sweep the same row three times and still miss what is right in front of you. This agent turns the shelf into a visible coverage map: 3 layers x 3 segments = 9 cells that you mark scanned as you look at each cell and confirm, with a repeat warning when you re-scan a cell, a finish check that names every unscanned cell, a found stop when you confirm the item yourself, and an honest all-scanned-not-found summary that never pretends the item was found. Finding is always your own confirmation — this platform has no object recognition, so the agent never claims to see the item on the shelf. Everything lives in session memory only and is wiped when the agent closes.
name: shelf-sweep
